decisions.reason: With V=C, H(s)=I and unrestricted T=i, U_T(s)=exp(s), so U_T is not unitary and the evolved scalar density has trace exp(2). Declaring T real makes (U_T*U_T)'=iT U_T*H U_T-iT U_T*H U_T=0. Real negative and zero parameters remain mathematically valid; simulation consumers separately require nonnegative or positive real times.

The Definition expressly adopts the finite term-list access interface, whose Definition requires Q_wrap and G_wrap as separate composition/generation costs. Its own resource list also separates queries, gates, description bits and generator time and says an unavailable coordinate is not zero. The list does not waive the incorporated wrapper charges or assert those charges vanish; failing to repeat the supplier symbols is not a contradictory access contract. No mathematical or accounting repair is necessary.

F3 states the maximum-on-unit-vectors formula without its nonzero-domain qualification, although the inherited model permits ran Q=0. This is a nonfatal fact restatement defect: F5 already assigns zero norm to maps with a zero space, P=I is constant, and all reduced blocks and derivative bounds then vanish. Added the zero-domain convention to F3; the Statement and complete proof steps are unchanged.

The Input explicitly says that if any required coefficient, call, or certificate is unavailable, the algorithm returns no circuit; Step 2 explicitly requests a combined operator-error certificate. Scalar coefficient certificates alone do not establish that operator bound, but the procedure never claims they do or promises success without the combined certificate. Its correctness consumer likewise assumes the certificates required by the simulator in Given and uses the certified operator bound in Proof 2.1. Thus missing term-norm data legitimately selects the documented no-circuit branch rather than violating a claimed unconditional error guarantee.

The Statement correctly restricts strict positivity to s>0 and explicitly gives e_0 at s=0, but the unqualified Positive title misdescribes the endpoint. This is nonfatal: replaced it by Nonnegative. Also corrected Proof 1.1 to state propagation diagonal entries 1/2 at endpoints and 1 internally, as follows from each h_l having factor 1/2; the former degree wording obscured that normalization. The displayed H_0 and every Statement clause remain unchanged.
